translationRepairs: Soon he was removed and made Grand Master of Splendid Horses.
Soon he was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Horses.
In appointment idiom, 除 means to appoint (or transfer) to office; ‘removed and made’ reverses the sense of 尋除太僕卿, and ‘appointed’ restores it.
Wei was stationed at the Divine Martial Gate; his wife's cousin, a leader of the feathered guard, beat a straight officer at the palace gate, and Wei at once impeached him.
Wei was stationed at the Divine Martial Gate; his wife's junior paternal uncle (congshu), a leader of the feathered guard, beat a straight officer at the palace gate, and Wei at once impeached him.
其妻從叔 is the wife's junior paternal uncle of the collateral line, not a cousin; the proposed kinship wording matches the Chinese.
Sheng and the other four were all killed at Heyin, exactly as she had foretold.
Sheng and the other three were all killed at Heyin, exactly as she had foretold.
昇等四人 counts four men in all including Sheng, not Sheng plus four; ‘the other three’ restores the correct total.
